#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1'000'000'007;

long long pack(int a, int b) {
    return ((long long)b << 32) | (a & 0xffffffffLL);
}

int calculate(int n) {
    int size = 2 * n + 1;
    if (size < 0) {
        throw invalid_argument("Negative size");
    }

    vector<vector<long long>> dp(size, vector<long long>(size, 0));
    dp[0][0] = pack(1, 0);

    for (int depth = 1; depth <= 2 * n; depth++) {
        for (int opened = depth & 1; opened <= depth; opened += 2) {
            int sumA = 0;
            int sumB = 0;

            if (opened > 0) {
                long long prev = dp[depth - 1][opened - 1];
                sumA += (int)(prev >> 32);
                sumB += (int)prev;
            }
            if (opened + 1 < size) {
                long long prev = dp[depth - 1][opened + 1];
                sumA += (int)(prev >> 32);
                sumB += (int)prev;
            }

            dp[depth][opened] = pack((sumA + 1) % MOD, sumB % MOD);
        }
    }

    return (int)(dp[2 * n][0] >> 32);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << calculate(n) << endl;
    return 0;
}
